title: M4 smoke timing withholds most candidates and reverses one direction between search and confirmation

evidence.note: Only 6 of 18 search timings passed the preregistered quality gate; 4 of 6 confirmations passed. All 42 Evaluation receipts passed correctness, so withholding is measurement evidence rather than a correctness or admission failure.

Search passed quality and favored the baseline at 0.910697x. Confirmation then showed 1.110108x in the opposite direction but failed measurement quality. The protocol correctly withheld both a regression and a speedup claim.

The candidate passed all correctness checks and reported a 1.314286x search ratio with nine candidate pair wins, but measurement quality failed and no confirmation ran. GEMM-bias, SWIGLU and Adadelta retain smaller favorable ratios under the same limitation.

observation: The R2/C8/K8/N8 smoke shapes are valuable for correctness and protocol coverage but often produce sub-microsecond kernels whose signal competes with host, command-buffer and external-GPU variation. Dispatch amplification is already 64, so increasing it by assumption would repeat the failed reasoning recorded in F-2026-09-10-010. The evidence establishes insufficient certified signal on this target/shape set; it does not identify the noise source and cannot rank the withheld kernels. Timing-model and measurement coverage are target-specific owners, so no M1/M2 threshold or calibration may be inherited.
proposed_change: Keep current quality gates and withhold unstable ratios. Add a bounded family9 measurement pilot over frozen artifacts that varies one declared condition at a time: aggregate command-buffer duration, dispatch amplification and exclusion/observation of other GPU clients. Select a future recipe only from a preregistered stability criterion, then use representative task shapes for performance campaigns while retaining smoke shapes for correctness/protocol coverage. This belongs to Lab study/measurement policy, not Compiler lowering.
verification_plan: Replay the retained timing samples to preserve current classifications. Run the same frozen baseline/candidate pairs under each pilot condition, require the quality gate to pass without changing its thresholds after observation, and repeat one known close-null pair plus the bias-gradient material pair. A successor recipe must reduce withheld measurements without changing correctness, pair order or materiality policy.
